title: CoLearn pipelines
about: What the dashboard on GitHub Pages watches. Each workflow shows its latest run per branch, with the failed jobs and steps, the failure streak and the last pass behind a red one; a workflow may name its own branches, or "any" for a manual one that runs from wherever it was started. staleAfterHours turns a pass amber once it is older than that and marks a workflow overdue when nothing ran within it. blocks says, in words, what a failure stops; blocking says whether something downstream actually waits on it.
